description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to querying and filtering usage sessions, including parsing query terms, matching sessions against query filters, and summarizing tool usage from content.

methods.name: extractQueryTerms
methods.description: Parses a query string into structured query terms, supporting quoted values and key-value pairs.

methods.name: matchesUsageQuery
methods.description: Determines if a usage session matches a specific query term based on various session attributes.

methods.name: filterSessionsByQuery
methods.description: Filters a list of sessions based on a query string, returning matching sessions and warnings.

methods.name: parseToolSummary
methods.description: Analyzes content to count tool usage and generate a summary string.
